assertions.name: interface_ratio_matches_convention_D_colour_weighted
assertions.source: Re-derived from q_0 in this file: z = q³/(q²+1) (convention D, owner ruling R1 2026-08-15), h = q - 1/q, δ = flavor_split_leading(q); interfaces (p-p, p-n, n-n) = (z, z - h(1/2 - δ/4), z - h) per R3. Pins the frame of the emitted value; it is NOT an accuracy check — no independent oracle for |tr_M(⁴He)| exists in this frame, see data.cross_check_status.

description: Canonical |tr_M(⁴He)| via Phase 5q closed form: tr_M(𝓑_⁴He) = tau_p² · tau_n² · ∏_i f_i(q) where f_i ∈ {positive=z, negative=z-h, averaged_weighted=z-h(1/2-δ/4)} per interface (canonical colour-weighted p-n, owner ruling R3). Replaces the deprecated disjoint-product witness atomic-tr-m-helium4.witness.json (PR #564 audit). NOTE the Phase 5q empirical slow-path agreement (1e-49) was measured in the convention-C, plain-σ frame and does NOT validate this value — see data.cross_check_status.

supersedes.reason: disjoint-product extension on H_12 fails the Schur-Weyl identity Σ_λ y_λ χ^λ = tr_M by ~5x per PR #564 audit; this canonical-word closed-form path is the canonical replacement. (The '1e-49 vs the empirical slow path' agreement that used to be quoted here is convention-C / plain-σ and is not a check on this value — see cross_check_status.)

cross_check_status.detail: The empirical slow path in closed_form_tau_M_verification_phase5q.py is bound to the chi_lambda_braid convention via marshal_to_chi_lambda_braid, and its recorded run is convention-C. It therefore validates the closed form as a 22M×-faster reimplementation of the OLD MARSHALLING — a check on the machinery, not on the p-n treatment. Producing a real cross-check needs a marshal_to_bring_color_weighted slow path, which does not exist. Until then the value here rests on closed_form_tau_M plus the frame assertion above.

lean_uniqueness_ref.note: These theorems certify T_w uniqueness at the abstract empty-constraint SDP level (PR #1537/#1542 parameterised module). The real per-nucleus SDP (multi-term cost + non-empty constraints) is per-nucleus substantive open work. Workplan: docs/workplans/2026-05-31-witness-lean-uniqueness-ref-wiring.md.

caveats: No independent oracle: the Phase 5q empirical slow-path agreement is convention-C / plain-σ bound and does not validate this value. See data.cross_check_status.
